notes.title: League of Tacticians is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, kalamayin here from Oba Games!

After many late nights and countless cups of tea, we're thrilled to announce that our passion project, League of Tacticians: Path of Tarkan, is now available on Steam!

[previewyoutube=9YnUpMGP5kE;full][/previewyoutube]

In the full game, you'll experience:

[list]
[*] Complete Season Story: Follow Tomyris's journey as she tries to restore her tribe's honor in the War League.

[*] 18 Tactical Battles: Engage in a full season of battles, each with unique challenges and objectives.

[*] New Skills: Unlock and master new abilities to outsmart your rivals.
[/list]

 
If you played the demo and liked it, we think you’ll love what’s waiting in the full version.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to hear your feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216610/League_Of_Tacticians_Path_of_Tarkan/

— Oba Games
